summary: In the Sustainability subplan you take the five foundational courses and at least 3 units in each of the four elective categories, at least 28 units in all, with no course used twice and at most 16 units of EARTHSYS 323 counted. In the Environmental Justice subplan you take EARTHSYS 194, one course each in movements, ethical frameworks and practice, EARTHSYS 134, and 12 units of Cardinal Courses, which may also count for the other requirements, for at least 24 units. Every course must be letter graded when that option exists and passed with a D- or better. You check by hand a petitioned non-Cardinal community-engaged course and the 2.0 GPA.

program.why: Grading: "All courses counted toward the minor must be taken for a letter grade, except when a letter grade option is not available, and must be passed with a grade of at least D-."
